blocks.title: New Feature: Blizzard Checkout
blocks.body: Purchasing Loot Boxes has never been easier. Our streamlined system gives players access to more payment options from directly within the Overwatch client.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Decreased the volume of passing cars with the Oasis background in the Hero Gallery

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that was allowing Mercy to resurrect players that had fallen off the map to their death

blocks.title: Maps
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug to prevent the garden point on Oasis from being contested/capped from the second-floor walkway above it
- Fixed a bug that allowed Sombra to reach unintended locations on several maps
